meta.note: boundaries are shifted away from round calendar dates because the indivisible unit is a relatedness cluster, not an isolate

escape.title: Evolutionary risk of substitutions
escape.summary: Reference: rpoB|isolate_0000|2024-01-01 (500 aa) · Sequences: 900, used 900 · Observed substitutions: 444 · Candidates not yet observed: 60 · Period: 2024-01-01 — 2024-09-02

tables.name: observed_mutations
tables.title: Observed substitutions, by descending risk
tables.note: Risk is the geometric mean of three factors: how far the profile tolerates the substitution, its physicochemical salience, and its novelty. Growth per week appears where the headers carried dates.

tables.name: candidate_mutations
tables.title: Candidates: substitutions not yet seen in the data
tables.note: This list is the early-warning mechanism: a substitution can be scored before it is ever seen. The estimate comes from a profile model and does not account for epistasis — how other substitutions change the effect.

tables.title: Hotspots: positions with the most substitution diversity
rows: H25K, H25P, H25R, H25Y, H25N, H25T

tables.note: Repeated independent substitutions at one position are a classic signature of positive selection: evolution keeps revisiting that site.
